_what: Where tool:list-connections (do-work/list-connections.mjs) reads a person's connections. Both lists are handed in by the caller's AI, never read here: the connection records (the person's own `connection` records, id `connection:` + the connection id encoded as a URL component) as connection_records, and the vault's held connections by their names alone (the account files read `held_connections`, trillion-rust src/account_files/account-files-routes.json, as { connection_id, fields }) as held_connections. connection_id_prefix is how a connection id begins, `service_connection:<vendor>` or `service_connection:<vendor>:<account>` (tools/connect-a-service-and-seal-its-key read-data/read-service-connection-options.ts deriveConnectionInstanceId; trillion-rust src/tool_runs/tools.rs connection_of), so a connection with no record is named by its vendor.
